name: JCFpmPhys
description: Representation of a single interaction of the JCFpm type, storage for relevant parameters

attributes.name: initD
attributes.description: equilibrium distance for interacting particles. Computed as the interparticular distance at first contact detection.

attributes.name: isBroken
attributes.description: flag for broken interactions

attributes.name: isCohesive
attributes.description: If false, particles interact in a frictional way. If true, particles are bonded regarding the given

attributes.name: more
attributes.description: specifies if the interaction is crossed by more than 3 joints. If true, interaction is deleted (temporary solution).

attributes.name: isOnJoint
attributes.description: defined as true when both interacting particles are on joint and are in opposite sides of the joint surface. In this case, mechanical parameters of the interaction are derived from the ''joint...'' material properties of the particles. Furthermore, the normal of the interaction may be re-oriented (see Law2_ScGeom_JCFpmPhys_JointedCohesiveFrictionalPM.smoothJoint).

attributes.name: isOnSlot
attributes.description: defined as true when interaction is located in the perforation slot (surface).

attributes.name: tanFrictionAngle
attributes.description: tangent of Coulomb friction angle for this interaction (auto. computed). [-]

attributes.name: crossSection
attributes.description: crossSection=pi*Rmin^2. [m2]

attributes.name: FnMax
attributes.description: positiv value computed from tensile strength (or joint variant) to define the maximum admissible normal force in traction: Fn >= -FnMax. [N]

attributes.name: FsMax
attributes.description: computed from cohesion (or jointCohesion) to define the maximum admissible tangential force in shear, for Fn=0. [N]

attributes.name: jointNormal
attributes.description: normal direction to the joint, deduced from e.g.

attributes.name: jointCumulativeSliding
attributes.description: sliding distance for particles interacting on a joint. Used, when

attributes.name: tanDilationAngle
attributes.description: tangent of the angle defining the dilatancy of the joint surface (auto. computed from

attributes.name: dilation
attributes.description: defines the normal displacement in the joint after sliding treshold. [m]

attributes.name: crackJointAperture
attributes.description: Relative displacement between 2 spheres (in case of a crack it is equivalent of the crack aperture)

attributes.name: momentEnergy
attributes.description: reference strain (or kinetic) energy of surrounding interactions (particles)

attributes.name: momentEnergyChange
attributes.description: storage of the maximum strain (or kinetic) energy change for surrounding interactions (particles)

attributes.name: momentMagnitude
attributes.description: Moment magnitude of a failed interaction

attributes.name: firstMomentCalc
attributes.description: Flag for moment calculation (auto-updated)

attributes.name: elapsedIter
attributes.description: number of elapsed iterations for moment calculation

attributes.name: momentCalculated
attributes.description: Flag for moment calculation to avoid repeating twice the operations (auto-updated)

attributes.name: computedCentroid
attributes.description: Flag for moment calculation

attributes.name: checkedForCluster
attributes.description: Have we checked if this int belongs in cluster?

attributes.name: originalClusterEvent
attributes.description: the original AE event for a cluster

attributes.name: clusteredEvent
attributes.description: is this interaction part of a cluster?

attributes.name: momentBroken
attributes.description: Flag for moment calculation

attributes.name: eventBeginTime
attributes.description: The time at which event initiated

attributes.name: interactionsAdded
attributes.description: have we added the ints associated with this event?

attributes.name: nearbyFound
attributes.description: Count used to debug moment calc

attributes.name: eventNumber
attributes.description: cluster event number

attributes.name: temporalWindow
attributes.description: temporal window for the clustering algorithm

attributes.name: momentCentroid
attributes.description: centroid of the AE event (avg location of clustered breaks)

attributes.name: clusterInts
attributes.description: vector of pointers to the broken interactions nearby constituting a cluster

attributes.name: originalEvent
attributes.description: pointer to the original interaction of a cluster

attributes.name: nearbyInts
attributes.description: vector of pointers to the nearby ints used for moment calc

attributes.name: strainEnergy
attributes.description: strain energy of interaction

attributes.name: kineticEnergy
attributes.description: kinetic energy of the two spheres participating in the interaction (easiest to store this value with interaction instead of spheres since we are using this information for moment magnitude estimations and associated interaction searches)

attributes.name: ks
attributes.description: Shear stiffness

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: kn
attributes.description: Normal stiffness

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
